_comment: Prevent Damage (2026-10-08, claude-play sweep seed 61003 T5). BREAKPOINT SITE 9 for a PingAll
source: a Pyrohemia CAST this main can activate {R} in the same phase. The T5 pre-combat frame
of that game (resumed at main 1, land drop unused): Tamanoa + Vito out and able to attack, four
lands, City of Brass + Pyrohemia in hand, us 16, opponent 15. Exact lethal T5: City of Brass,
cast Pyrohemia off the painful sources (each pain hit -> Tamanoa gain -> Vito drain), then ONE
{R} ping off the last land (1 to Tamanoa, Vito, us and the opponent = 4 dealt by a noncreature
source -> Tamanoa gains 4 -> Vito drains 4, plus the 1 direct), then Tamanoa 2 + Vito 1 attack.
The ping is reachable ONLY as a site-9 continuation (activations are enumerated against the
battlefield the plan started from, and site 9 is searched-only), so it needs PlanOpensBreakpoint
to fan out the Pyrohemia-casting plan -- CardHasPostEntryActivation's ping_all_cost clause.
CONTROL: MTG_POST_ENTRY_PING_ALL=0 (the pre-fix predicate) plays Dina + pain drains and wins T6,
at --depth 8 --budget-ms 0 too. Settings = the deck's shipped play settings (d5 b20).
